snippet.title: Alien: Isolation 2 Reveal Trailer | Last Chance
snippet.description:
Your mistake. It was expensive. That’s something the company rarely forgives. This is your last chance. Do you understand?

Alien: Isolation 2 will be available on XBOX Series X|S, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2 and Steam. Wishlist now!

Microsoft Store: https://tr.ee/ve1ESH
PlayStation Store: https://tr.ee/MRwaPU
Steam: https://tr.ee/g4iM52
*Nintendo Switch 2 wishlisting not yet available.

Our channels
Discord: https://discord.gg/alienisolation
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/alienisolation/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/AlienIsolation/
X: https://x.com/AlienIsolation
Website: https://www.sega.com/alien-isolation

Alien: Isolation 2 is a single-player survival horror game developed by Creative Assembly and published by SEGA.

About The Creative Assembly™ Ltd.
Founded in 1987, Creative Assembly is a European games developer, creator of the multi-million selling Total War™ franchise which spans history and fantasy, and the critically acclaimed survival horror masterpiece Alien: Isolation. Creative Assembly continues to build an impressive portfolio of games including the recently announced Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000® in partnership with Games Workshop, Total War: MEDIEVAL III and Alien: Isolation 2 with 20th Century Studios. https://www.creative-assembly.com
